text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...To tell the truth... I really wanted to 
give you something more proper and 
special, something only I could give 
you...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A heroic saga with a protagonist 
resembling Kris S-san, the latest training 
books, a photo album of American 
landscapes...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
B-But... the more I thought about it, the 
less I knew what the right answer was...! 
In the endâ

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—This weight, the sound of the water. 
—You must have tailored the water to my 
exact liking.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes. I remember hearing before that 
you're quite particular about it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I tried to pick something as close as 
possible to what you usually drink...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I'm delighted. I'm sure it's delicious. 
—Thank you, Rob Roy.
